description:
How did U.S. politics get so divisive? In this episode of Crash Course Big Questions: U.S. Government and Politics, we’ll pull back the curtain on how Republican and Democrat became synonymous with “conservative” and “liberal,” and why politics today has gotten so polarized and personal.

Chapter 1 - Introduction: Political Polarization 00:00
Chapter 2 - Ideological Sorting 2:28
Chapter 3 - Social Sorting 6:24
Chapter 4 - Political Identities 7:57
Chapter 5- Consequences of Political Polarization 9:05
Chapter 6 - Review & Credits 10:59
